updates.name: Apply the plan's required promotion on a BYOD sale
updates.custom_requirements:
Feature: for plan 40L1WEB, UAT3 offers exactly one promotion, COUP_NEU3F3, marked "Required". This case checks the rep can select it, that only that one promotion is offered, and that it is carried through to the cart and the Order Summary.

WHAT COUP_NEU3F3 DOES (confirmed by the dev team 2026-08-27): it is a SERVICE-CREDIT promotion — "100% for 3 months" on the monthly service (card text: "Pay for 3 months service and get the 3 months on us... Requires 3 months payment upfront"). It is NOT a free-SIM promotion: the SIM card is still charged in full when it is applied (live UAT3 2026-08-27 showed SIM card $11.00 WITH the promotion applied). Any earlier wording on this case about the promotion re-pricing the SIM to $0 was WRONG and has been removed — do not automate a $0 SIM assertion here.

NO free-SIM promotion exists in the UAT3 catalog today (COUP_NEUFREESIM is not present). A genuine free-SIM promotion is a separate case and a data-seeding request, not part of this one.

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE FIRST RUN: a live screenshot shows the COUP_NEU3F3 card already in the "Selected" state on arrival. It is NOT established whether the app auto-selects a Required promotion or whether the rep had clicked it — confirm on the first run and correct step 5. The same question decides whether the skip-the-required-promotion guard is reachable from the UI at all.

Test data: IMEI = 359028039693195 (verified in UAT3). SIM = an unused SIM number from the RTGO Data workbook (UAT3 SIMs sheet). Plan = 40L1WEB. Promotion = COUP_NEU3F3.

Reference values seen live (UAT3, 2026-08-27) with protection MCPY selected: SIM card $11.00, Protection (MCPY) $16.00/mo, Plan (40L1WEB) $40.00/mo, Promotion (COUP_NEU3F3) "100% for 3 months", Estimated monthly $56.00, Total due $67.00. Sanity check only — monthly figures move with protection/add-on choices. The assertions that must always hold: the single promotion card, the promotion line in the cart, the SIM charge remaining, and cart-versus-Order-Summary agreement.

Jira: QA-2694.

steps.action: Create the account, pass ID verification, enter the IMEI, click Continue on the "Imei not found" window, choose Android, enter the SIM
steps.expected: Phone number selection page; cart shows Device $0.00 and a SIM card charge plus tax

steps.action: Choose a phone number and Continue, then pick a protection offer (or Skip)
steps.expected: Plan selection page opens (the protection choice does not change this case)

Promotion selection page opens with the header text "Great news, customer is eligible for 1 promotions. Select then continue below." — exactly ONE promotion card is shown, no second card anywhere on the page. The card reads "6-Month Unlimited Plan", carries the badge "100% for 3 months" and a "Required" tag, and shows the code COUP_NEU3F3

steps.action: Make sure the promotion is selected (record whether it arrived already selected — see the open question)
steps.expected: The card shows "Selected"; Continue is available

The promotion is accepted; the cart gains the line "Promotion (COUP_NEU3F3)" showing "100% for 3 months". The SIM card line KEEPS its full charge — this promotion does NOT make the SIM free. Device stays $0.00

steps.action: Continue through add-ons (Skip), Create Subscriber, and open the Order Summary
steps.expected: Order Summary repeats the COUP_NEU3F3 promotion and the same amounts as the cart, including the unchanged SIM charge
